# اِعْتَرَضْتِ (iʕtaraḍti) /iʕ.ta.radˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اِعْتَرَضَتْ (iʕtaraḍat) /iʕ.ta.ra.dˤat/: third-p
